name: Hello Bot
description: Example plugin: replies to whoever types !merhaba and counts how many times they were greeted.
details:
A small example for anyone learning to write plugins. It greets whoever types !merhaba in chat and counts how many times that person has been greeted (the count is stored in Bunker, so it survives restarts).

The code is open: see the examples/hello folder in the plugin SDK's GitHub repository.
author: Bunker
